All features test: teacher, students and Super Admin on real screens

25 November 2026 · the main branch · run on the Mac, not on Windows

Result

Every feature I could run here works. One teacher window and two student windows were driven through each feature by pressing what is on the screen. No screen showed an error and the server logged none. Three small things were found (below). AI could not be tested here.

Three small things found

1. The activity log leaves out the student's name for report cards. The lines read "published the report card of" and "froze the report card of", and then stop. The wording is in apps/client/src/features/home/AuditPanel.tsx.

2. The student home does not update by itself when the teacher adds a book. Bala's home still said "Nothing here yet" under My books after the teacher added five items. It was right after he pressed Home again. Notices, quizzes and polls do appear by themselves.

3. The teacher's attendance list does not update by itself. This is the same one as in yesterday's report. The data is right; the screen is late.

Library and files

  • The teacher added five things for Class 7, Maths, chapter Fractions.
  • The Word file was refused with: "Word, Excel and PowerPoint files need LibreOffice on the Server PC, and it is not installed there." That is the right answer on this Mac. Turning a Word file into a PDF was not tested.
  • Asha saw all five under My books and opened the book, the picture and the video.
  • She played the activity and got 8 of 10. The teacher opened the activity and saw "Asha Patil, 8 of 10, 1 try".

Quizzes

  • The teacher wrote "Fractions check" with 3 questions and saved it.
  • Live, in 2 teams. Both students pressed "Join the quiz". Asha was put in Red, Bala in Blue. Asha scored 3 of 3, Bala 1 of 3. The teacher saw answers arrive live and the final places at the end.
  • As practice. It showed under Things to do with no clock. Bala tried twice: 1 of 3, then 3 of 3. The app kept "Best so far: 3 out of 3, Tries: 2". His real quiz average stayed at 33%, so practice is not counted.
  • The Today screen and "How I am doing" showed the right averages afterwards.

Showing to the class

  • Video. The teacher pressed "Show to Class 7". The video opened by itself on both student PCs, over whatever they were doing. On play and pause both stayed within 0.1 seconds of the teacher.
  • Pen. The teacher wrote on the video and both students saw the line. Asha pressed "Ask for the pen", the teacher pressed Allow, and her line showed on every screen with her name.
  • Stop. On "Stop showing" the video left both screens and each student was back where they had been.
  • Whiteboard and book. Both opened on the student PCs. The teacher's writing and page turns followed.

Work, notices, playlists, notes

  • The teacher set "Fractions worksheet" out of 10. Asha wrote her answer and handed it in. The teacher gave 8 with a comment. Asha saw "You got 8 out of 10" and the comment.
  • A notice for Class 7 and a notice for the whole school both showed at the top of the student home.
  • The playlist "Fractions week" showed under Things to do. After Asha opened step 1 it said "1 of 2 done".
  • Asha wrote a note and it was saved.

Report cards and Super Admin

  • The teacher made report cards for Class 7. Asha: quiz average 100%, grade A+, work 80%. Bala: 33%, grade E. The numbers match the quiz and the marked work.
  • The teacher saved remarks and published Asha's card. The Super Admin then froze it; it can no longer be changed.
  • "What teachers have done" showed Ravi K: 1 quiz made, 2 run, 2 students reached.
  • With "Lock the lab PCs when no class is booked" switched on, both student PCs showed "The lab is closed for now" within 5 seconds. They opened again when it was switched off.

Not tried

  • Real Windows PCs. All of this ran on the Mac, with the app in a browser stand-in and not in the installed Windows app.
  • AI. The test server has no AI kit, so Ask AI, Plan a lesson, Make quiz with AI and the student tutor only showed their "not installed" message.
  • Word, Excel and PowerPoint to PDF. There is no LibreOffice on this Mac.
  • Our locked videos (the .ictlock files) and the locked-down student PC (no right-click, print or download). Both need the real Windows app.
  • The smart board.
